name: Cavern of Souls
oracle_text:
As this land enters, choose a creature type.
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell of the chosen type, and that spell can't be countered.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell of the chosen type, and that spell can't be countered.

needs.what: uncounterability that rides on the mana a restricted mana ability produced -- a flag on the mana ability (beside its `mana_restriction`) saying "a spell this mana helped cast can't be countered", carried through payment onto the spell object and read by the `counter` op. The engine already records which permanents' mana abilities paid for a spell (`objects.py:158` `mana_sources_spent`, written by `costs.py:1577`), so what is missing is a load-time key for the claim and a third arm in `ops_stack._shielded_by_a_static`'s caller (`ops_stack.py:387`) that asks whether any oid in `item.mana_sources_spent` belongs to an ability making it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The two uncounterable mechanisms in `reference` both decide from printed characteristics alone and neither can see the mana. The card-level rider `uncounterable` (`carddef.py:919`, read at `ops_stack.py:387`) is one card saying it about *itself*, so it cannot cover the creature spell Cavern funds. The static effect `spells_cant_be_countered` is the closest -- it does protect other players' spells and it does take an optional `affects_spells` filter -- but that filter is matched by `_matches_printed(card, filt)` (`ops_stack.py:283`), printed characteristics only, and `static_filter_keys` has no `paid_by` or any other way to ask which permanent's mana was spent. Writing it as `spells_cant_be_countered` with `affects_spells: {"types": ["Creature"], "subtypes": [{"chosen_type_of": "self"}]}` is a strictly better card than the printed one: every creature spell of the chosen type would become uncounterable whether or not Cavern's mana paid for it, and it would leave Cavern's third printed line claimed by two abilities, which the residual gate reads as a line nobody owns. The `paid_by` key that asks exactly this question exists only in *trigger* filters (`triggers.py:1401`), and a trigger cannot stop a counterspell that is already resolving. No op grants it either: `grant_rebound` and `grant_plot` write a flag onto a spell on the stack, but there is no `grant_uncounterable`, and a mana ability may in any case carry only `add_mana`/`choose_mode` plus a rider from {add_counters, add_poison, damage, gain_life, lose_life, remove_counters}, none of which touch the stack.
needs.note: The rest of the card is already expressible and should be written the moment this one clause is: `choose_type` on a `self_enters` trigger plus `mana_restriction: {"cast": [["creature", {"chosen_type_of": "self"}]]}` is exactly Secluded Courtyard, which ships in data/cards/auto/templates.cards.json.
